description: List the knowledge-base index (design languages, UI components, UX, craft, books, process, marketing, SEO, GEO, patterns). Returns every document grouped by category — each with its id, title, platform, and tags. Use this first to discover what's available and get exact ids; then read one with get_design_doc, or search by need with search_design_knowledge.

category.description: Filter to one category, e.g. 'component', 'ux', 'marketing'. Omit for all.

platform.description: Filter to one platform: 'mobile', 'web', or 'macos' (docs marked 'both' are always included). Omit for all.

name: list_design_knowledge
title: List Design Knowledge
